newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Hayleys Photoprint in bonus, rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Hayleys Photoprint in bonus, rights issue.

text.p: Hayleys Photoprint Ltd said in a statement on Tuesday it was making a bonus and rights issue which would double its current issued capital of 1.5 million shares.
"The rights issue of one new share for every two held at 10 rupees, is on the increased capital after the bonus issue," the statement said.
The bonus issue is in the ratio of one new share for every three held.
Hayleys Photoprint is a subsidiary of blue-chip conglomerate Hayleys Ltd.
The share was last traded at 19.50 per 10-rupee share on Tuesday.
